summary: Flathead NF lookout listed as a frame cupola cabin in 1928, given an L-4 cab in 1939, abandoned in 1950 and now gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Frame cupola cabin (1928); L-4 cab added in 1939
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1950 per firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts says removed; no removal date given

events.note: Listed as a frame cupola cabin for 1928
Listed as receiving an L-4 cab in 1939

evidence.supports: frame cupola cabin in 1928, L-4 cab in 1939, abandoned 1950, now gone
evidence.quote: 1928: frame cupola cabin. 1939: L-4 cab. Abandoned 1950. Gone.

evidence.supports: about 12 miles south of Spotted Bear Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 12 miles south of Spotted Bear R.S.

evidence.supports: page title calls it a cabin
Forest Lookouts marks it as removed
Montana list classes it as a ground site and marks it gone

notes_for_editor: Brief said kind ground; the firelookout.org list reads Ground for this site, so the kind is consistent with it. Only two short pages and one index line exist; no staffing, fire, access or present-day information was found. Access is left out of facts because no source gives a level. Two WebSearch calls found nothing on this lookout. Removal year unknown, so no removed event.
